messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: Metering pipeline - delayed emits + overage-suppression observed for subset of customers. Alert: metering-emitter-high-latency (P2) - triggered 09:12 UTC
liam-eng-sre: I'm taking the oncall handoff, joining now
slo-oncall: acknowledged, grabbing context and will page infra if needed
mike: seeing a ~30% drop in token counts for US and EU on the billing dashboard, some accounts flagged as 'overage suppressed'
tara-billing: confirmed, billing automation set suppression flag for ~120 accounts in the last 20m
anya-support: two customers opened tickets reporting usage not appearing since ~09:12 UTC, passing to billing for interim ETA
kevin-ops: initial look shows emitter-consumer backlog on kafka-partition-13, consumer offsets stuck at 1234567, consumer process reporting timeouts to count-service
liam-eng-sre: tailing logs on emitter-consumer-2 -> repeated write timeouts to count-service, snippet: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-17T09:15:23Z","svc":"emitter-consumer-2","err":"write timeout","offset":1234567}
```
liam-eng-sre: also noticed a config change in last deploy: token-windowing.kv_ttl set to 0 unexpectedly
mike: which deploy changed KV TTL? need the deploy id
kevin-ops: deploy 2026-03-17_0910 by infra-deploy-bot touched metering-configs
slo-oncall: mitigation plan (live):
  1) pause consumer autoshutdown to prevent further churn
  2) restart emitter-consumer-2 to rejoin consumer group
  3) trigger backlog replay for affected window range
  4) hold automated overage charges for impacted accounts
liam-eng-sre: executing step 1/2 now, will report when restart completes
anya-support: preparing customer comms, ETA 30m, draft in #support-drafts
tara-billing: putting affected invoices/accounts on hold to prevent charge automation (manual hold)
liam-eng-sre: restart done, emitter-consumer-2 rejoined, offsets resuming
kevin-ops: backlog draining at ~115k msgs/min after restart, estimate full catch-up in ~18m
mike: monitoring billing dashboard - counts recovering to ~98% after partial replay
pagerduty-bot: Incident update: acknowledged by slo-oncall, mitigation in progress
liam-eng-sre: ran a quick replay for offsets 1,234,500-1,235,000, no errors during replay, sample sanity check matches pre-incident counts
kevin-ops: adding throttle to consumer retry loop to avoid reintroducing timeouts to count-service
anya-support: customer emails sent (IDs: 12345,12346) with apology and ETA; will update if timeline changes
tara-billing: overage automation paused for impacted accounts, billing hold notes added to affected customer profiles
slo-oncall: moving to monitoring - keeping thread open for 1h then handoff to postmortem owner
mike: preliminary RCA: config drift (KV TTL set to 0) combined with a consumer restart race caused emitter backlog and delayed emits. Follow-ups: revert risky deploy, add validation on TTL, add alert for emitter lag > 60s
liam-eng-sre: creating follow-up tasks and assigning: @kevin-ops -> deploy gate + validation, @mike -> billing reconciliation + invoice sweep, @anya-support -> final customer follow-up
kevin-ops: documenting steps in runbook and adding a guard in deploy pipeline: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-emitter
mike: creating postmortem ticket PM-2026-03-17-01 and linking incident artifacts
liam-eng-sre: thanks all, leaving notes in the repo and will attach logs to PM
slo-oncall: last update 10:35 UTC - metrics stable, backlog drained, no new suppression flags. If no regression we'll close pager in 30m
pagerduty-bot: Incident mitigated by slo-oncall and liam-eng-sre - status: mitigated
kevin-ops: :thumbsup: leaving the channel, follow-up owners pinged
anya-support: will follow up with customers after postmortem is ready
